1x01.d: As Mohinder Suresh seeks answers about his father's recent death, ordinary people around the world begin to exhibit extraordinary abilities. Claire Bennet, a high school cheerleader, learns she is indestructible. Peter Petrelli dreams he can fly, and as he tries to put this to the test, his brother Nathan reveals something he never suspected. Niki, a single mother, fears she's losing her mind.

1x02.d: Peter confronts Nathan about what happened in the alley. Hiro explores New York and finds a comic book detailing his experiences, before making an awful discovery. Niki and Micah are preparing to run when she discovers she's had unexpected assistance. Mohinder meets a friend of his late father and begins uncovering clues.

1x03.d: Niki finds a clue related to her estranged husband's disappearance and confronts her mother-in-law. Claire attends a bonfire with disastrous consequences. Hiro returns to the present and attempts to enlist Ando 's assistance. Peter struggles to discover the nature of his powers. Mohinder and Eden make a gruesome discovery about Sylar that could have implications for Nathan.

1x04.d: Matt awakens to find himself face-to-face with Mr. Bennet and the mysterious man from the bar. Claire recovers from her autopsy and returns to school, where a discovery about Brody prompts her to seek revenge. Niki works out an arrangement with Linderman, but as she gets cold feet, her alter-ego takes over. Hiro and Ando explore Las Vegas, but are sidetracked from their mission.

1x05.d: At "Future Hiro's" urging, Peter and Isaac come together and begin to formulate a plan. Nathan escapes from Mr. Bennet, meets Hiro, and realizes he's been blackmailed. While Claire recovers from the car accident unscathed as always, when her father becomes involved Brody isn't as fortunate. As Niki looks forward after becoming free of her debt to Mr.

1x06.d: Niki 's alter-ego finally reveals herself, leading to a dramatic showdown between her and DL. Peter delivers his message to Hiro. Isaac discovers a painting of his is missing, and it could be the key to saving the cheerleader. Hiro and Ando are roped in by the high roller they cheated, but find themselves in the midst of a bloodbath.

1x07.d: Matt uses his power to find out a shocking secret about his wife as he and Audrey encounter a new evolved human, Ted Sprague. Peter saves the day for Nathan when a reporter asks about his time in Las Vegas, however he wants something in return. Jessica takes over Niki, and prepares to go after Micah. Micah is revealed to have an ability.

1x08.d: When Mohinder returns to India for his father 's funeral, he seems content to stay... until he begins to have unsettling dreams. With Eden 's help, Isaac seems to have kicked his heroin habit, but Mr. Bennet 's needs jeopardize his efforts. Hiro meets a remarkable waitress named Charlie, but because of Sylar, he's diverted yet again from his quest.

1x09.d: Claire and Jackie come under attack at Homecoming. Despite Nathan 's best efforts to protect him, Peter finds the missing painting he's been looking for, thanks to Simone. Ando continues to wait for a vanished Hiro. As Jessica plots revenge, Micah convinces D.L. that Niki needs their help. With the help of Sanjog Iyer, Mohinder finds proof of extraordinary powers and chooses his destiny.

1x10.d: Hiro time travels too far, but still tries to save Charlie, to no avail. Chandra Suresh finds and tests a potentially powerful evolved human. Claire ’s life changes while her father finds out she’s special. Nathan recruits Peter to help him prosecute Mr. Linderman. Niki gets a surprise visit from family. Mr. Bennet gives Eden a chance for a new life. Matt tries to pass the detective test.

1x11.d: When Matt and Audrey follow up on a lead in the Sylar case, Matt discovers problems with his abilities that he has experienced before. As Peter is held for questioning, he continues to have strange dreams. When Claire tells her father the truth, he reveals he already knew of her abilities, even before she did. Mr. Bennet and his organization imprison Sylar in a maximum protection cell.

1x12.d: As Peter remains comatose, Nathan searches for clues about his brother's dreams. His powers depleted, Hiro begins a quest for a means to strengthen them. Mr. Bennet struggles to unravel the mystery of Sylar. When Matt 's investigation hits a dead-end, he attempts to reconcile with Janice. D.L. attempts to settle his family's debt to Mr. Linderman.

1x13.d: Peter meets Claude and asks for his help. Hiro and Ando are abducted. Niki is offered help in dealing with Jessica. D.L. comes to terms with raising Micah alone. Matt integrates his power into his personal life. Claire and Zach try to track down Claire's mother.

1x14.d: Claude helps Peter deal with his distractions. Claire meets her birth mother. Hiro faces his father and sister. Sylar encounters Mrs. Bennet while continuing his quest for Claire's power. Simone and Isaac speculate about their future. Niki 's attempt to control Jessica takes some surprising turns.

1x15.d: Matt and Jessica 's new jobs bring them together. Mohinder tries to contact evolved humans from the list. Sylar resumes his efforts to collect new powers. As Sandra Bennet 's health declines, Claire seeks a connection with her birth parents. Nathan travels to Texas to see Meredith. Hiro and Ando attempt to help a showgirl in Las Vegas.

1x16.d: Matt meets with Ted and a new 'wireless' hero, and plans to get revenge on Mr. Bennet, while also dealing with his decision to keep the diamonds. Mohinder and Sylar go on a road trip, encountering an evolved human with the ability of enhanced hearing. Simone pays the price as Peter and Isaac 's rivalry comes to a head. Mr.

Flashbacks reveal more about Mr. Bennet's company. Claude is revealed to be Mr. Bennet's ex-partner, and he is punished for going against The Company. Mr. Bennet's deception of Sandra begins. Kaito gives Claire to Mr. Bennet.

1x18.d: Peter and Isaac each deal with the aftermath of Simone 's death. The Haitian 's attempt to lead Claire to safety takes an unexpected turn. As Jessica seeks to complete another assignment for Mr. Linderman, Niki begins to assert herself. Hiro 's quest for the sword reaches its conclusion. Nathan Petrelli 's relationship with Mr. Linderman comes to a head as they meet face-to-face. Mr.

Peter and Sylar 's fight ends badly for both. Claire learns more about her biological family from her grandmother, and finally meets her biological father. Isaac becomes a hero. Mohinder seeks help in stopping Sylar.

1x20.d: Hiro and Ando experience the future timeline in which the explosion wasn't stopped. The President makes a serious decision with drastic consequences. Constantly on the run, Claire tries to lead a normal life. Peter must make a choice between trying to change the past and living in the present. 1x21.d: Hiro and Ando attempt to stop Sylar. Sylar returns home to visit his mother. Ted, Matt, and Mr. Bennet continue their journey to New York to disable the Company's tracking system. Mohinder joins Thompson and searches for a cure for Molly Walker. D.L. and Jessica look for Micah. Peter tries to persuade Claire to stay and help him prevent the explosion.

1x22.d: Hiro and Ando try to get the sword fixed, and meet someone unexpected. Peter tries to leave New York City with Ted and Claire. The people of New York City turn out to vote. D.L. and Jessica continue the search for Micah. Matt and Mr. Bennet find the tracking system. Sylar kills again.

1x23.d: Niki and D.L. reunite with Micah. Niki finally dominates over Jessica and unleashes her strength for the first time on her own. Matt, Mohinder, and Bennet use Molly to find Sylar. Peter has another dream. Ando confronts Sylar. Everyone converges on Kirby Plaza for the final showdown. Mr. Bennet, Matt, Niki, Peter and Hiro heroically battle Sylar. Nathan makes a tough decision regarding the future.

2x01.d: Claire and her family adapt to their new life in Costa Verde. Mohinder and Noah 's plan to take down the Company goes into action as Mohinder is offered a job. Matt finally succeeds in the detective exam, but has something new to deal with as Molly begins having strange dreams. Ando and Kaito Nakamura learn Kaito's life is in danger.

2x02.d: Peter tries to escape from captivity. Matt and Detective Fuller investigate the death of Kaito Nakamura. Hiro does what is necessary to restore the honor of Takezo Kensei. Niki and Micah separate and move on with their lives. Maya does what is necessary to free Alejandro in their quest to go to America. Hiro sends a message to Ando in the future about his journey with Takezo Kensei.

2x04.d: Angela confesses to a murder. Claire and West spend some time together. Nathan begins to put his life back together. Matt learns Molly 's "Nightmare Man" is someone familiar. 2x05.d: Matt and Nathan try to find answers. Hiro continues his journey with Kensei. Monica and Micah explore her new-found ability. Mohinder looks to help Molly, while dealing with other evolved humans. Peter finds new abilities. A mysterious woman seeks out a hero at any cost. Matt discovers a new trick.

2x09.d: Noah tries to save Claire and his family. Hiro attempts to save his father and learns a horrible truth. Matt turns to his ability to get what he wants. Elle, Bob, and Mohinder go on a mission.

2x10.d: Claire and her family try to move on. Elle attempts to regain Bob 's trust. Mohinder tries to find a cure for Niki 's mutated virus. Monica uses her ability to become a hero. Sylar 's manipulation of Maya and Alejandro takes a devastating turn. Peter and Adam find some answers. Hiro and Ando learn more about the past. Niki reunites with Micah.

2x11.d: Peter tries to prevent the release of the virus. Nathan and Matt help reveal Adam 's true intentions. Sylar holds Maya, Mohinder, and Molly hostage to get his abilities back. Elle attempts to get back into her father 's good graces. Hiro 's quest to avenge his father 's killer comes to a climax. Niki makes the ultimate sacrifice in order to save Monica.

3x01.d: Nathan is rushed to hospital, where he receives a visit from a familiar face he thought he would never see again. Matt finds himself transported to somewhere unexpected as he uncovers the identity of Nathan's shooter. Hiro receives a final message from his father and encounters a "speedster", before seeing his death by someone shocking in a trip to the future. Sylar pays Claire a visit.

3x02.d: Sylar goes to Primatech, and collects another ability from Bob. Tracy 's power is revealed, as a reporter threatens her reputation. Angela takes control of the Company. Nathan takes up on Tracy's offer. Elle 's life falls apart as she accidentally causes the Level 5 prisoners to escape. Mohinder experiences the side effects of his new found abilities, as he and Maya begin a relationship.

3x03.d: Noah is given a new partner. Tracy goes to New Orleans to find answers about Niki. Nathan is sworn into office. Meredith teaches Claire a hard lesson. Peter is forced to help rob a bank. Hiro and Ando track down Daphne and the formula.

3x04.d: Peter travels to a very different future. Matt looks into his own future. Tracy learns more of her past from Dr. Zimmerman. Mohinder experiences unexpected side effects of his formula. Tension grows between Ando and Hiro.

3x09.d: Ando and Hiro are forced to start over. Peter and Claire are on the run. Matt attempts to awaken Angela. Elle and Sylar have a shaky reunion. Nathan visits his father. Mohinder discovers crucial information. Tracy cuts a deal with Pinehearst.

3x10.d: A second eclipse causes the loss of abilities and the emergence of panic, frustration and confusion. Sylar and Elle go to retrieve the catalyst. Nathan and Peter search for The Haitian. Matt discovers Daphne 's secret. In hiding, Noah teaches his daughter how to fight. Hiro and Ando search for the next 9th Wonders! comic. Tracy begins organizing an army for Arthur.

3x11.d: The eclipse 's effects are felt by all. Peter tries to be a hero without his powers. Claire finds herself on her deathbed and without her father. Noah hunts down Sylar and Elle. Matt helps Daphne resolve family issues. Hiro and Ando look to an unlikely source to restore Hiro's memory. Mohinder rebels against Arthur. Nathan makes a decision. The Haitian battles his brother Samedi.

3x12.d: In 1991, Hiro and Claire seek " the light." The Haitian accompanies Peter to Pinehearst to confront his father. Nathan takes command of Arthur's operation. Tracy helps Nathan assemble a small army of Marines. Matt, Daphne, and Ando try to find Isaac's last issue of 9th Wonders!. Sylar seeks the truth about his parentage. Arthur and Mohinder take the last steps in developing the formula.

3x13.d: Peter and Nathan clash. Sylar holds Noah, Claire, Angela, Meredith and others hostage at Primatech. Ando, Daphne, and Matt figure out how to save Hiro. Tracy's loyalty to a helpful Peter is tested when Nathan offers her an enticing deal. Sylar gets information about his father and meets up with Luke, a young outcast much like himself who wants to help.

Claire receives a mysterious tip from " Rebel ", urging her to save Alex from Noah. Tracy briefly escapes her cell, and kills a Building 26 employee. Hiro and Ando travel to India to fulfill one of Matt's drawings.

Flashbacks reveal: Angela and her sister's discovery of their abilities. Charles Deveaux 's ability. The involvement of Chandra Suresh in a government program. The founding of the Company. 4x03.d: Sylar taunts Matt during an investigation. Peter meets Samuel. A new hero is introduced. Claire shares a secret with her new roommate.
